findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: Concurrent callers can all observe a nil cache at lines 41–43, then queue on this lock. After the first caller loads and stores the assets, every queued caller still proceeds to read the manifest because the cache is not checked again under the lock. This causes redundant serialized file or CDN reads during startup; recheck the cache after acquiring the lock for non-development environments.
